latest_final: The man has been buried alive in a man-made enclosure with no usable way out. When he strikes a match, he recognizes someone he knows, whom he had not believed to be dead. That person is already dead and is in the enclosure with him. Their identity reveals something about his immediate, already-fatal situation, but they do not cause his death. The air in the enclosure has too little oxygen, and trapped there, the man dies in terror and despair. The clues do not establish why the oxygen is low or how the other person died.
